description: Narrative Synthesis Templates for Enneagram Results

low_short.pattern_summary: A pattern around {CORE_THEME} seems to be emerging in your responses. At this early stage, this is more of a direction than a destination — {TYPE_NAME} themes are present, but not yet clearly dominant.
low_short.confidence_framing: This is still forming. Short assessments offer a starting point, not a conclusion — and that's exactly how they're designed. Clarity often arrives through reflection over time, not from answering more questions.
low_short.reflection_prompt: This may become clearer as you notice when this pattern shows up in your daily life.

low_deep.pattern_summary: A pattern around {CORE_THEME} emerges from your responses, though it shares space with other active themes. {TYPE_NAME} tendencies — {MOTIVATION_HINT} — appear to be one significant thread among several.
low_deep.confidence_framing: Even with a deeper exploration, this pattern remains fluid. That's not unusual — some people's core patterns take longer to surface clearly, and that ambiguity itself can be information worth noticing.
low_deep.reflection_prompt: Consider what resonates about this direction — and what doesn't. Both responses are valuable data.

moderate_short.pattern_summary: A pattern around {CORE_THEME} stands out in your responses. {TYPE_NAME} themes — {MOTIVATION_HINT} — appear to be a significant part of how you navigate the world.
moderate_short.confidence_framing: This pattern shows up consistently in your short assessment, though a deeper exploration would add more dimension. Many people find their initial pattern holds, while others discover nuances that shift the picture.
moderate_short.reflection_prompt: You might notice when this pattern feels most active — and what's happening around you when it does.

moderate_deep.pattern_summary: A pattern around {CORE_THEME} stands out consistently across your responses. {TYPE_NAME} themes — {MOTIVATION_HINT} — appear to be a significant part of how you navigate the world.
moderate_deep.confidence_framing: This pattern appears reliably across your deep assessment, though it's not the only one present. Many people carry elements of nearby types, and that complexity is normal — not a sign of unclear results.
moderate_deep.reflection_prompt: You might notice when this pattern feels most active — and what happens when you're not in it.

moderate_deep_crosslens.scenario: Moderate confidence + Deep assessment + Cross-lens applied
moderate_deep_crosslens.pattern_summary: A pattern around {CORE_THEME} emerges from your responses, with {TYPE_NAME} themes appearing most prominent. This reflects how you answered, not who you are — though the two are often related.
moderate_deep_crosslens.confidence_framing: This pattern appears consistently, and other lenses gently support the same direction. That convergence adds context, not certainty — multiple perspectives pointing similarly is interesting, not definitive.
moderate_deep_crosslens.reflection_prompt: Notice whether this pattern resonates in your lived experience — that's the real test, not any assessment.

high_any.pattern_summary: {TYPE_NAME} patterns appear clearly and consistently in your responses. The core theme — {CORE_THEME} — shows up across different question types and contexts.
high_any.confidence_framing: This pattern appears with clarity. That doesn't make it a permanent label — all patterns are lenses, not cages — but the signal here is strong enough to work with directly.
high_any.reflection_prompt: Pay attention to when this pattern serves you well — and when it might be worth loosening its grip.

wing_not_clear.pattern_summary: A pattern around {CORE_THEME} stands out in your responses. {TYPE_NAME} themes appear clearly, though your wing — the adjacent pattern that flavors your core — isn't yet defined.
wing_not_clear.wing_context: Both neighboring types ({WING_LEFT} and {WING_RIGHT}) may be accessible to you, or one may emerge more clearly over time. This ambiguity isn't a problem to solve; it's information about where you are right now.
wing_not_clear.reflection_prompt: Notice which adjacent pattern — {WING_LEFT_THEME} or {WING_RIGHT_THEME} — feels more familiar in your daily life.

wing_balanced.pattern_summary: A pattern around {CORE_THEME} stands out in your responses. {TYPE_NAME} themes appear clearly, and you show access to both adjacent wings.
wing_balanced.wing_context: You show access to both wings — {WING_LEFT} and {WING_RIGHT}. Rather than defaulting to one pattern, you may draw on different adjacent energies depending on context. Balance here isn't confusion; it's range.
wing_balanced.reflection_prompt: Observe when you lean toward {WING_LEFT_THEME} versus {WING_RIGHT_THEME}. The choice may be more conscious than you realize.

cross_lens_context_templates.astrology_only: Your birth chart echoes similar themes, adding texture without adding certainty.
cross_lens_context_templates.human_design_only: Your Human Design configuration resonates with this pattern, offering another angle on the same question.
cross_lens_context_templates.both_sources: Other lenses — your chart and design — gently point in a similar direction, though all of these remain exploratory.
cross_lens_context_templates.strong_concordance: Multiple perspectives seem to converge here, which may be meaningful — though convergence isn't confirmation.
